verdict.rationale: Docs confirm refunds can be created via API and manually via the Mollie Web app (dashboard), and idempotency docs explicitly warn about partial refund double-execution risk, implying partial refund support. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'partial refund' field/amount parameter or dashboard UI screenshot showing partial vs full refund selection. missing for 10: explicit API reference showing partial refund amount parameter, dashboard UI walkthrough for partial refunds, independent/hands-on confirmation of dashboard refund flow.
